decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 31st March 2005, the erection of a roof extension measuring a width of 5.6m, a height of 2.6m and a depth of 4.0m and a hip to gable alteration measuring 8.5m wide, 2.8m high with a perpendicular depth of 3.9m, were lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - Informative:

If you commence work on the ground floor extension (00170/131/P2), for which planning permission was granted on the 24/5/05, before you have completed the roof extension you will invalidate the lawful development certificate for the extension hereby deemed lawful.  As a result you will be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20000.  It is also likely to make the property difficult to sell.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for roof extension to house.
